summary: DarkIris Inc., a Hong Kong-based Nasdaq-listed AI media technology company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 30, 2026, providing a routine business update rather than announcing a corporate transaction. The disclosure covers pre-launch compliance and testing for its Cine3.AI film production platform, formation of wholly owned US subsidiary DarkIris US Inc. as a North American operating hub, a global senior-talent recruitment initiative across Singapore and the US, and development of the Quantum Project X strategy game. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or transaction terms were stated. No special-situation event exists; no deal terms to track.
